properties.name: SelectedPumpId
properties.description: Pump whose curve-fit quality is reported in OutCurveR2

properties.name: MotorCurrentLimit
properties.description: Motor current (A) above which a pump is overloaded: opens events and costs health score

properties.name: OutCurveR2
properties.description: R squared of the selected pump's head-flow curve, written by Calculate Pump Curves

properties.name: OutWorstPumpId
properties.description: Pump with the lowest health score, written by Score Pump Health

tables.name: PUMP_CURVES
tables.description: One row per pump: head-flow curve coefficients fitted from the rows that pass Fleet Filters.

R Squared.description: Coefficient of determination of the pump's curve fit

tables.name: PUMP_HEALTH
tables.description: One row per pump with a fitted curve: 0-100 health score, its drivers and the rank (1 = least healthy).

Health Score.description: 100 minus the curve, load and trip penalties

Load Ratio.description: 95th percentile motor current divided by MotorCurrentLimit

Next Review.description: Date of the next engineering review (as-of date plus 7 days)

dataFunctions.name: Score Pump Health
dataFunctions.description: Ranks the pumps by a 0-100 health score from the curve fit, the motor current of the rows in the active filter and the share of tripped samples. Reads PUMP_CURVES, so the builder runs Calculate Pump Curves first.

inputs.name: PUMP_CURVES
inputs.description: Curve fits written by Calculate Pump Curves

inputs.name: operatingData
inputs.description: Operating rows that pass the active filtering scheme

inputs.name: fleetCurrent
inputs.description: Motor current of the rows that pass Fleet Filters (fleet reference)

inputs.name: fleetAvgCurrent
inputs.description: Average motor current of the rows in the active filter

inputs.name: reviewWindow
inputs.description: Time from the as-of date to the next review

outputs.name: PUMP_HEALTH
outputs.description: One row per pump with a fitted curve

outputs.name: OutWorstPumpId
outputs.description: Pump with the lowest health score

dataFunctions.name: Calculate Pump Curves
dataFunctions.description: Fits a head-flow curve per pump from the rows that pass Fleet Filters and reports the fit quality of the selected pump.

inputs.name: PUMP_DATA
inputs.description: Operating rows that pass Fleet Filters

inputs.name: flowRate
inputs.description: Flow of every row (fleet reference for the median flow)

inputs.name: minPoints
inputs.description: Fewest rows a pump needs for a curve

inputs.name: specificGravity
inputs.description: Specific gravity of the pumped liquid

inputs.name: excludeTripped
inputs.description: Drop rows whose Status is Tripped

inputs.name: maxFlow
inputs.description: Highest flow in PUMP_DATA, where the curve head is evaluated

outputs.name: PUMP_CURVES
outputs.description: One row per pump with enough points

outputs.name: OutCurveR2
outputs.description: R squared of the selected pump's curve

dataFunctions.name: Detect Pump Events
dataFunctions.description: Rebuilds PUMP_EVENTS from over-current episodes in the marked pump rows. Not run at build: refresh it from Data > Data function properties after marking pumps.

inputs.name: historyStart
inputs.description: Samples before this time are ignored

outputs.name: PUMP_EVENTS
outputs.description: Replaces the rows of the loaded events table
